 Bolex Catalog
 Paillard Products Inc., NY
 Content: 24 pages
 Year: November 1952
 Language: English
 Both the Pan Cinor 20-60 zoom lens and the Bolex Stereo attachment are pictured on the cover of this US catalog, but neither are discussed; they're only included in the retail price list. The rest of the catalog gives a general overview of Paillard Bolex cameras and accessories and Kern lenses for 8mm and 16mm. 
 Bolex Catalog
 Paillard Products Inc., NY
 Content: 24 pages
 Year: 1952
 Language: English
 Unfortunately, I've "misplaced" this catalog -- meaning, "permanently lost". Fortunately, I scanned it before that happened. This particular one is from 1952, but the month is unknown; it's similar to the above issue, printed in the US by Paillard Products Inc. Both were a series of catalogs, updated occasionally, which included Paillard Bolex products. As far as I know, there were only two styles of covers. 
 8 - 9,5 - 16mm Movie Equipment
 Paillard S.A., Switzerland
 Content: 32 pages
 Year: 1953
 Language: English
 This product catalog was printed by Paillard and intended for the British market. It's a great source of information on many of the Bolex products available as of early 1953, including some less common accessories -- many of which were not distributed or advertised in North America.
 Scan: Courtesy of Jim Exley, UK.
 Kern Paillard Lenses
 Paillard S.A., Switzerland
 Content: 24 pages
 Year: 1954
 Language: English
 This catalog, printed in Switzerland, is devoted entirely to Kern Paillard lenses for 8mm and 16mm Bolex cameras. All lenses are fully detailed and pictured, along with an illustration of the lens element construction for each. The cover shows a woman holding a Bolex H16 Supreme.
 Kern Lenses (Includes Reflex)
 Paillard S.A., Switzerland
 Content: 24 pages
 Year: 1957
 Language: English
 Featuring a slightly different cover model from the earlier printing of this catalog, this version shows a full line of both standard and reflex Kern lenses. Bolex product codes and specifications of reflex lenses are listed, but it is otherwise identical to the catalog pictured above.
 General 8mm Catalogue
 Paillard Ltd., Ste-Croix (Switzerland)
 Content: 20 pages
 Year: 1959
 Language: English
 This catalog, for the British market, shows a range of Paillard-Bolex products for 8mm movies that were available in 1959. The inside front cover has an excellent exploded view illustrating the different parts of the Bolex B8L.
 Scan: Courtesy of Jim Exley, UK.
